## Detailed Project Portfolio

### 1. Yellow (`yellow`)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ARYAN-04/yellow
- **Primary Tech**: Go (Golang), TypeScript, SQLite
- **Architecture & Highlights**:
  - High-performance tournament and bracket management engine with deterministic pairing algorithms.
  - Implemented secure admin middleware authentication and relational schema with SQLite foreign key constraints.
  - Automated participant check-in workflows and live match state management.

### 2. FIFA Watch-Along (`fifa-watch-along`)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ARYAN-04/fifa-watch-along
- **Primary Tech**: Python, TypeScript, Machine Learning, NLP
- **Architecture & Highlights**:
  - Real-time match telemetry stream and live commentary companion platform.
  - Retrained ML time-decay weighting model to dynamically balance live sentiment and match importance.
  - Responsive web interface featuring live telemetry cards and match stream updates.

### 3. Aviation Load Factor Analysis (`aviation-load-factor-analysis`)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ARYAN-04/aviation-load-factor-analysis
- **Primary Tech**: Python, Pandas, Jupyter, Streamlit, Scikit-learn
- **Architecture & Highlights**:
  - Predictive modeling pipeline analyzing commercial aviation seat occupancy factors and route profitability.
  - Refactored monolithic notebook data pipelines into modular Python packages.
  - Built an interactive Streamlit analytics dashboard for real-time scenario simulation and parameter exploration.

### 4. Health Monitor Daemon (`health_monitor_daemon_project`)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ARYAN-04/health_monitor_daemon_project
- **Primary Tech**: Python, Linux Systemd, Bash
- **Architecture & Highlights**:
  - Background monitoring daemon tracking server telemetry, CPU utilization, memory thresholds, and disk I/O.
  - Configured automated alerting and structured log rotation for headless Linux server environments.

### 5. Stock Pricer LSTM (`stock_pricer_LSTM`)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ARYAN-04/stock_pricer_LSTM
- **Primary Tech**: Python, TensorFlow, Keras, LSTM
- **Architecture & Highlights**:
  - Deep learning sequential model predicting historical stock price trajectories using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) recurrent networks.
  - Incorporated time-series normalization, sliding window preprocessing, and visual error loss convergence tracking.
